## Invariants

### adapter

| Invariant | Subject | unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `adapter.failure_never_passes` | `adapter.python` | ✅ |
| `adapter.level_from_runner` | `adapter.python` | ✅ |
| `adapter.never_truncates` | `adapter.python` | ✅ |
| `adapter.silent_without_runner` | `adapter.python` | ✅ |
| `adapter.skip_records_skip` | `adapter.python` | ✅ |

- `adapter.failure_never_passes` — A test that fails, errors or panics never records pass.
- `adapter.level_from_runner` — The level a record carries comes only from TEMPER_LEVEL; no test can set it.
- `adapter.never_truncates` — The adapter only appends, to a file unique to its process; it never truncates or removes evidence.
- `adapter.silent_without_runner` — Without TEMPER_LEVEL and TEMPER_EVIDENCE the adapter records nothing and changes nothing.
- `adapter.skip_records_skip` — A skipped test records skip.
